notes.title: Diabetes Management — Diagnosis & Treatment
notes.content:
Type 2 Diabetes — Diagnosed January 8, 2026
Doctor: Dr. Sarah Kim, Princeton Medical Center

Diagnosis:
- A1C: 7.8% (target: <7%)
- Fasting glucose: 168 mg/dL (target: 80-130)
- Diagnosed after routine physical — had been feeling tired for months

Treatment plan:
- Metformin 500mg twice daily (morning and evening with food)
- Diet modification: Low-carb, 1800 calories/day
- Exercise: 30 minutes walking, 5 days/week
- Blood sugar monitoring: Before breakfast and 2 hours after dinner
- Follow-up: Every 3 months (next: April 10, 2026)

My feelings about this:
- Honestly in denial. My father had diabetes and lost his eyesight at 72.
- Don't want to worry the kids, especially Alex (he's got enough on his plate)
- Linda is being wonderful but a bit overbearing with the diet police routine
- Told Alex and Sophie but downplayed it. Said "it's just a little sugar thing"

Goals:
- Get A1C under 7% by July checkup
- Lose 15 lbs (current: 195, target: 180)
- Actually follow the diet (struggling)

notes.title: Diet Plan — Low Carb 1800 Cal
notes.content:
Diabetic Diet Plan — Dr. Kim's Recommendations
Target: 1800 calories/day, <130g carbs/day

Breakfast options:
- 2 eggs + spinach + 1 slice whole grain toast
- Greek yogurt + berries + almonds
- Oatmeal (1/2 cup steel cut) + walnuts

Lunch options:
- Grilled chicken salad (large, with olive oil dressing)
- Turkey lettuce wraps + vegetable soup
- Salmon + steamed vegetables

Dinner options:
- Grilled fish + roasted vegetables + small portion brown rice
- Chicken stir-fry (no noodles, extra vegetables)
- Lean steak + side salad + sweet potato (small)

Snacks (2/day):
- Handful of almonds or walnuts
- Celery + peanut butter (2 tbsp)
- Hard-boiled egg
- Cheese stick

Foods to AVOID (my weaknesses):
- White pasta (my favorite — Sunday gravy tradition is hard to give up)
- White bread
- Soda (gave up already)
- Cookies/cakes (except rare occasions)
- Large portions of rice

Reality check: Following this maybe 60% of the time. Need to do better.
Linda made a meal prep schedule but I sneak snacks when she's at work (not proud of this).

notes.title: Medication Side Effects Notes
notes.content:
Metformin Side Effects — Tracking

Started: January 12, 2026 (500mg 2x daily)

Side effects experienced:
- GI issues: Moderate. Nausea after taking on empty stomach (first 2 weeks was bad, now better if I eat first)
- Stomach cramps: Occasional, usually first thing in morning
- Fatigue: Hard to tell if this is the medication or the diabetes itself
- Metallic taste: Occasional, annoying but manageable
- Decreased appetite: Actually helpful for weight loss goal

What helps:
- Always take with food (breakfast and dinner)
- Drink extra water
- Avoid very fatty meals when taking pill

Timeline:
- Weeks 1-2: Worst GI effects, considered asking doctor to stop
- Weeks 3-4: GI effects reduced by ~50%
- Month 2+: Mostly manageable, occasional bad days

Dr. Kim said:
- GI effects usually resolve by month 3
- If still problematic, can try extended-release version
- DO NOT stop taking without consulting her

Note: Haven't told Alex about the side effects. He'd worry too much.
